q1.question: What is a customized ERP system?
q1.answer: A customized ERP system is configured and developed to match your specific business processes, workflows, and reporting needs — rather than forcing your team to adapt to generic software.

q2.question: Can AIODYX customize Odoo for my business?
q2.answer: Yes — that is exactly what we build. We do not hand you a default Odoo copy; we deliver a system designed around your real processes from day one.

q3.question: Can the system connect to our existing software?
q3.answer: Yes. We build integration points with the systems you want to keep — instead of replacing everything at once.

q4.question: How long does it take to build a full ERP system?
q4.answer: It depends on the number of modules and the complexity of your processes. We set a clear timeline during the business analysis stage, before building begins.

q5.question: Do you train our team to use the system?
q5.answer: Training is a core part of the launch stage — not a separate add-on service.

q6.question: Does the system support Arabic and English together?
q6.answer: Yes, fully — the interface, reports, and technical support are available in both languages.

q7.question: Does support continue after launch?
q7.answer: Yes. We monitor system performance and improve it continuously after launch, and add new modules when needed.

q8.question: Can modules be added later?
q8.answer: Yes. ERP systems are modular by design. You can add new modules and capabilities as your business grows and requirements evolve.
